Rules for P06's order test against P05, written before the pool is read or any order computed; not an amendment. Question: in rooms where keepers stop or turn their repair once a change is known as the room's own (P05's revised clause), does attribution (P06) come first? (1) Pool: rooms with an accepted P05 line whose ruling reason, as last adjudicated, matches the finding aid 'intended|planned|agreed change|once told|are told|told the|until told', and that also show P06 (a P06 tag row). Each hit is read; a room stays in the pool only if its P05 reasons name a concept where keepers stop, cease, apologise, switch to helping, or give up erasing a change once it is known as planned or the room's own (the stop). (2) H_stop is the hour of the earliest such stop concept in the room, read through cite.py. H_att is the hour of the room's earliest concept in its P06-shown rows, any form; H_om is the earliest in rows tagged OM or FF (the room's own mistake or friendly fire, the form that could be the telling); hours are taken from the checked spec rows. (3) The order holds in a room when H_att is before H_stop; equal hours are ties; I report both H_att and H_om. Rooms with a stop and no earlier attribution are the negative cases. (4) No count chooses a revision: no correction is met twice here, so the test makes no move in this leg; its result goes to the notes and is carried to D3c and D4, where an arrow would also need a mechanism and a negative check. Next: d3_p06p05_pool.py to list the pool's P05 reasons

Order test, pool step 1 by d3_p06p05_pool.py (output d3_p06p05_pool.txt): the finding aid matches accepted P05 lines in 31 rooms; 28 show P06. Read against rule (1), 8 rooms' P05 reasons name a stop by keepers: chelseafc (an apology for covering intended red), dwarffortress (an apology for repairing a planned edit), luciomains (keepers accept the changed eye), mcgill (c0064 stands down), ohio (apologise and switch once told), pathofexile (an apology after missing the new version), ripcity (c0139 stops refilling), weezer (c0080 apologises). The other 20 name a telling, a request to stop, builders giving a change up, or repairs that go on, and no stop. Addition to rule (1), dated D3a-50 and logged before any H_stop is read: the first aid catches the telling and misses stops worded without it, so a second finding aid, 'apolog|stands? down|ceas|stop(s|ped)? (repair|refill|fix|undo)|switch(es|ed)? once|once told|turn(s|ed)? to help', is run over accepted P05 lines and its rooms are read by the same test; the rest of the rules stand. Next: d3_p06p05_pool_v2.py

Order test, pool step 2. d3_p06p05_pool_v2.py (output d3_p06p05_pool_v2.txt): the second aid matches 16 rooms, 7 not matched by the first, all 7 showing P06; their reasons name a stop in neopets, norge, southafrica, tf2 and timbers, and none in berserk (a keeper explains the mistake, no stop) or ftlgame (a request to stop). The 13 candidate lines' concepts, listed by mem.py adaptations, were quoted by d3_cite_many.py into d3_p06p05_stop_cites.txt (49 concepts). Under rule (1), each room's stop is its earliest stop concept among those quotes; dwarffortress leaves the pool, since none of its five quotes is a stop. The pool is 12 rooms, with their stops in d3_p06p05_stops.txt. Disclosure: the pool files print H_att beside the reasons, so I saw those hours and the stop hours before the order script ran; the stops were chosen by rule (1), the earliest stop concept, and not by the hours. Next: d3_p06p05_order.py

P06's order test against P05, result by d3_p06p05_order.py over the 12 pooled rooms: H_att against H_stop before 8, tie 2, after 2; H_om gives the same counts, since each room's first P06-shown row carries OM or FF. Before: chelseafc, luciomains, mcgill, neopets, ohio, ripcity, southafrica, weezer; tie: tf2 and timbers, where the stop and the attribution are one post (c0310; c0025); after: norge and pathofexile, where the stop answers a builder's telling (c0017; c0138) that no P06 line codes. Read by episode from the P06 rows (grep of the P06 spec files): in mcgill, neopets, ohio and weezer, a coded attribution about the same change comes just before the stop (c0063, c0047, c0089, c0079); in tf2, timbers and southafrica the stop itself is a coded admission (c0310, c0025, c0153); in chelseafc, luciomains and ripcity the first P06 act concerns another change, and the stop answers a telling that no P06 line codes (c0172 and c0186; c0038; the post before c0139). So in every pooled room the stop follows a telling, as P05's statement says since move 173; the telling is a coded attribution of the room's own mistake or friendly fire in 7 rooms and an uncoded telling in 5. Ruling under the logged rules: no arrow and no move. The order is P05's stated mechanism, P06's own-mistake and friendly-fire forms are one form of its telling, the pool is 12 rooms found by phrase, and no correction is met twice. Carried to D3c and D4: whether P05's telling clause should name P06 (relating), weighed in the clustering. Next: the notes
